business_summary: Bringspring Science and Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the smart healthcare business in China. It operates through Health Care and Social Security, Government and Public Utilities, and Others segments. The company offers medical record statistics, medical record tracing, digital medical records, and paperless medical record management; smart healthcare solutions for core clinical scenarios; and clinical information system construction and upgrades for emergency care, including triage and emergency records, electronic medical record generation, RFID smart wristbands, smart queuing, and emergency assistance, as well as ICU and perioperative digital platforms, including IoT-based ICU monitoring and clinical data services with predictive models, and anesthesia systems for risk assessment, intraoperative monitoring, and postoperative follow-up. It also offers triage guidance, waiting-information push, in-clinic workflows, and post-diagnosis health education; IoT-connected real-time clinical data collection and intelligent analysis; and remote ICU visits, surgical education support, and AI-assisted intelligent nursing robots with video monitoring and early warning. The company provides data quality control, DRG/DIP data support, BI reporting, automated data collection and testing, and Rongjia Houqin, a smart logistics platform for equipment, energy, sewage, emergency, and logistics management; builds regional healthcare and medical insurance platforms for government agencies, supporting DRG/DIP supervision, intelligent auditing, medical insurance cost control, medical quality control, digital medical record management, and 5G-enabled regional emergency medical services; and smart medical insurance, digital HR/social security, long-term care insurance, medical insurance checks, digital grid solutions, hybrid cloud operations, IT maintenance, zero-trust security, scanning, and database AI auditing. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Shenyang, China.
